subject: Boston Avenue Bike Infrastructure Redesign
overview: The Medford Bicycling Advisory Commission met to approve minutes, adjust its meeting schedule, establish an outreach working group, and review recent community events. The commission devoted most of the meeting to evaluating redesign concepts for Boston Avenue near Tufts University and discussing winter snow removal plans for bike corridors.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission approved the minutes from its September meeting.

items.title: November and December Meeting Schedule
items.summary: The commission voted to cancel its individual November and December meetings and combine them into a single meeting on December 9, 2026.

items.title: Commission Membership and Outreach Working Group
items.summary: Members discussed applicant recruitment and voted to establish a working group focused on traditional media, newsletters, and social media outreach.

items.title: Event Recaps and Tabling Materials
items.summary: Commissioners recapped public outreach at Tufts Community Day, Harvest Your Energy, and a Walk Medford meeting, discussing ideas for future interactive tabling displays.

items.title: Wellington Greenway and Fellsway Bridge Updates
items.summary: Members received brief status updates on the Wellington Greenway Phase 4 trail project and ongoing construction of the Fellsway underpass bridge.

items.title: Tufts Boston Avenue Redesign Project
items.summary: The commission reviewed design concepts for Boston Avenue between Winthrop Street and College Avenue, expressing concern over narrow door-zone bike lanes and agreeing to advocate for designs prioritizing dedicated bike space, speed tables, and parking reallocations.

items.title: Winter Snow Removal Planning
items.summary: The commission agreed to contact city administration with problem locations to request a clear plan for winter snow clearance on primary bicycle corridors.
